def semver_sort(versions):
    def parse_version(version):
        # Split build metadata (everything after '+')
        if '+' in version:
            version_part, build = version.rsplit('+', 1)
        else:
            version_part = version
        
        # Split pre-release (everything after first '-' that comes after MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH)
        # First find MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
        parts = version_part.split('-', 1)
        base = parts[0]
        prerelease = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else None
        
        # Parse MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
        base_parts = base.split('.')
        major = int(base_parts[0])
        minor = int(base_parts[1]) if len(base_parts) > 1 else 0
        patch = int(base_parts[2]) if len(base_parts) > 2 else 0
        
        # Parse pre-release identifiers
        prerelease_identifiers = []
        if prerelease:
            for identifier in prerelease.split('.'):
                # Check if identifier is all digits
                if identifier.isdigit():
                    prerelease_identifiers.append((0, int(identifier)))  # 0 = numeric
                else:
                    prerelease_identifiers.append((1, identifier))  # 1 = string
        
        return (major, minor, patch, prerelease_identifiers)
    
    def sort_key(item):
        index, version = item
        major, minor, patch, prerelease = parse_version(version)
        
        # For sorting: version without prerelease comes after version with prerelease
        # So we use (major, minor, patch, has_prerelease, prerelease_tuple, original_index)
        # has_prerelease: True (1) if no prerelease, False (0) if prerelease exists
        has_no_prerelease = len(prerelease) == 0
        
        return (major, minor, patch, has_no_prerelease, prerelease, index)
    
    # Create list of (original_index, version) to maintain stable sort
    indexed_versions = list(enumerate(versions))
    
    # Sort by the key
    sorted_versions = sorted(indexed_versions, key=sort_key)
    
    # Extract just the version strings
    return [version for _, version in sorted_versions]
